results.rationale: Both say the −600 ms result measured Tailwind removal, which changed styling and layout cost; the proposed replacement remains untested.
Both identify baseline instability without a code change and avoid attributing a result to code; each appropriately limits what the control-host transfer establishes.
Both report that the estimators reverse the Sol/Astra ordering, so the ranking is unresolved; Y also notes the withdrawn claim.
Both separate the dollar recalculation and reserve figures as model-based from the limited direct pool evidence; neither presents the 1.6× estimate as established.
Both state weekly_scoped is a cap within the common pool and do not attribute the counter increase to Fable; they account for the other project's turns.
Both recognize that method constraints and turn counts changed, so the cost difference does not isolate model capability; observed free-method outcomes are described accurately.
Both distinguish the initial 9/9 pass from the second-round 5/9 result and conclude full path coverage is unsupported.
Both report higher observed seq3 scores while treating superiority as unresolved given repeat variation and incomplete, noisy holdout coverage.
Both report the 0.50 pp observed difference and explain that unavailable paired outcomes prevent establishing a new SOTA; the rough interval includes zero.
Both give exact counts: instruction followed 20/20, work saved 15/20, and marker erased in 8 runs per arm. Both correctly identify what 20/20 measures.
Both state 12/12 for each field per model and calculate 180/180 correct model×field checks overall.
Both give the observed differences exactly: low exceeded medium by 1 and max by 2 acceptances, without claiming a population-level effect.
